quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་སྤྱི་དོན། སྐྱབས་སྤྱིའི་རྣམ་གཞག་གི་སྐབས། p390, the explanation of the Uttaratantra verse on why three refuges are set out
quotes.why: The distinction the whole p391–p395 debate turns on: the Buddha one is to attain oneself is the result refuge, the Buddha already accomplished in another continuum is the cause refuge. Everything about 'one continuum' follows from this.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་གྱི་སྐབས། the same refutation of other-continuum cause refuges that p392 gives
quotes.why: Chökyi Gyaltsen's own ground, in his mtha' dpyod, for the premise p393 is attacking: 'Buddha superior' is of one continuum with every bodhisattva because it is each one's final object of attainment.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་གྱི་སྐབས། the parallel to the first half of p393
quotes.why: The same objection and the same Indra counter-example in Chökyi Gyaltsen's mtha' dpyod, where the subject of the absurd consequence is named outright as 'Buddha superior' and Indra's reason is 'a sentient being of one continuum with him'. Found by the pack; read in context.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་གྱི་སྐབས། continuation of the same parallel
quotes.why: Supplies the step the སྤྱི་དོན leaves to the debater: accepting that Indra is certain to reach Śākyamuni's state would commit the opponent to every sentient being's being certain to reach it.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་གྱི་སྐབས། the parallel to the second half of p393
quotes.why: Establishes, in Chökyi Gyaltsen's own voice, the claim the paragraph presents in a single 'we said' clause: Māndhātṛ is Śākyamuni at the present time, because there is a time at which he became Śākyamuni.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་གྱི་སྐབས། the reply to the argument that the སྤྱི་དོན records at p394 and leaves unanswered
quotes.why: The mtha' dpyod answers the counter-attack that p394 closes with ཞེས་ཟེར and no reply: the reason 'at that time Śākyamuni is your cause' is simply not established.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་གྱི་སྐབས། a few folios after the parallel
quotes.why: The sharpest statement of the logic behind p393's second answer: being Śākyamuni 'at the present time' does not even entail existing at the present time, so it cannot entail simply being Śākyamuni.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་མཐའ་དཔྱོད། in the discussion of whether a Buddha can have been a sentient being
quotes.why: Chökyi Gyaltsen's scriptural warrant for the Buddha's having been Māndhātṛ, cited only as 'a sūtra'. Found by direct search.

quotes.file: Kangyur/8. DKON BRTZEGS_Pile of Jewels (Ratna Kūṭa)/VOL 4 (NGA)/KL00060E_'PHAGS PA YAB DANG SRAS MJAL BA ZHES BYA BA THEG PA CHEN PO'I MDO_An Exalted Sutra of the Greater Way entitled "The Meeting of the Father and the Son" (Ārya Pitā Putra Samāgamana Nāma Mahāyāna Sūtra)_unicode.txt
quotes.citation: Kangyur, Ratnakūṭa, ཡབ་དང་སྲས་མཇལ་བའི་མདོ། (Pitāputrasamāgama), the close of the Māndhātṛ story in its fifteenth bam po
quotes.why: The canonical source for the Buddha's identity with Māndhātṛ, in the jātaka formula 'do not think it was someone else — I myself at that time was the wheel-turning king Māndhātṛ'. Found by direct search of the Kangyur.

quotes.file: Kangyur/8. DKON BRTZEGS_Pile of Jewels (Ratna Kūṭa)/VOL 1 (KA)/KL00047E_'PHAGS PA DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA'I GSANG BA BSAM GYIS MI KHYAB PA BSTAN PA ZHES BYA BA THEG PA CHEN PO MDO_A Sutra of the Greater Way entitled "A Exalted Teaching on the Inconceivable Secret of Those Gone Thus"+_unicode.txt
quotes.citation: Kangyur, Ratnakūṭa, དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པའི་གསང་བ་བསམ་གྱིས་མི་ཁྱབ་པ་བསྟན་པ། (Tathāgatācintyaguhyanirdeśa), the story of Indra 'Good Eye'
quotes.why: A canonical instance of the premise p393 relies on, that the Teacher once took birth as Indra; the sūtra names Śākyamuni explicitly. Found by direct search of the Kangyur.

quotes.file: Kangyur/1. 'DUL BA_Vowed Morality (Vinaya)/VOL 2 (KHA)/KL00001E2_'DUL BA GZHI 2_Foundation of Vowed Morality, Part 2 (Vinaya Vastu 2)_unicode.txt
quotes.citation: Kangyur, Vinaya, འདུལ་བ་གཞི། (Vinayavastu), the Māndhātṛ avadāna
quotes.why: Shows why 'Indra' works as the subject of an absurd consequence: in the same story the paragraph draws on, six Indras die and are replaced while Māndhātṛ is still a boy. Indra is an office with many holders, not one individual. Found by direct search of the Kangyur.

quotes.citation: སྐབས་དང་པོའི་སྤྱི་དོན། the edition's variant-reading apparatus for this passage: the entry for witness ཀ, f. 147b6 (witnesses ག f. 116b1 and ཏ f. 100a6, listed just before it, read ཤཱཀྱ་ཐུབ་པ་ཡིན་བྱས་པ་ལ། ཁ་ཅིག)
quotes.why: The edition's own apparatus: witness ཀ reads 'if someone says [Māndhātṛ] is Śākyamuni' where the text printed here reads 'when [we] said ... some say'. That moves the Māndhātṛ claim from the author to an opponent.

quotes.citation: ཕར་ཕྱིན་མཐའ་དཔྱོད་རིན་ཆེན་སྒྲོན་མེ། (Gomang), first chapter, on whether the author of the Ornament must be a Buddha
quotes.why: Jamyang Zhepa uses the same device of a general subject ('Buddha superior') that p393 uses against its opponent: what is true of one Buddha does not transfer to Buddha as such. A Drepung Gomang parallel. Found by direct search.

quotes.citation: འགྲེལ་པ་དོན་གསལ། gloss on སངས་རྒྱས་ལ་སོགས་དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ། among the ten instructions
quotes.why: What Haribhadra actually says at the lemma: the instruction on the Buddha jewel is an instruction to not apprehend it. There is nothing here about cause and result refuges or about continua.
The root verse whose second line is the lemma this whole excursus on refuge hangs from.
